newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ultrana unit sells stake in power company.
newsitem.headline: Ultrana unit sells stake in power company.

text.p: Ultrana Energy & Resources Corp said its unit Magellan Capital Holdings Corp has sold its stake in Magellan Power Corp for 201.15 million pesos to local firm East Asia Diesel Power Corp.
In a disclosure to the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) on Wednesday, Ultrana president Robert Cokeng said that all conditions of the stock purchase agreement has been complied with.
Cokeng said 31.25 million shares, or 50 percent of the outstanding capital stock of the company, was sold

The proceeds of the sale will be used by Magellan Capital for investment in two of its power generation subsidiaries namely Magellan Utilities Development Corp (MUDC) and Magellan Cogeneration, he added.
